title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ（瀬川明夫研究室）
subtitle: Design Project III(Segawa Akio)
teachers:
SEGAWA Akio
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) Acquire the ability to identify and solve problems to research, develop, design, and manufacture socially useful and high-quality products using the basic knowledge learned in the Department of Mechanical Engineering. (2) Learn what technologies or new mechanisms are needed for that purpose. (3) Learn about the importance of collaboration with society (particularly local communities).
advice:
This is the final comprehensive course in the Department of Mechanical Engineering. To realize the educational objectives of the Department of Mechanical Engineering, this course focuses on the following goals:

Students will acquire the ability to model phenomena accurately and analyze the models.
Students will acquire the ability and the engineering sense to evaluate solutions using the obtained results.

In practice, students should reconfirm their project theme, which was determined in Preparatory Seminar, with the supervisors of the individual laboratories. (The theme should be revised as necessary.)
Students are expected to pursue the identification and solution of problems in accordance with the engineering process.

Our laboratory employs plasticity and forming processing and related techniques. In addition, we aimed to train highly skilled and capable engineers. By studying rolling and forging processes, production technology having high added value is established, and products with high functionality are created. Furthermore, problems from different fields are addressed in cooperation with other local universities and companies.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Understand the purpose of your project theme and the advancement process accurately, and achieve the established annual goal. In addition, the process can be reported in the Design Project Activity Support System.
(2) Compile the intermediate results for the project into the interim report, and present and discuss its content. Complete the final report, present it to the Design Project III Public Presentation Review Board, and discuss its content.
(3) If necessary, design and manufacture your own experimental devices, and also evaluate the performance of the product.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Understand the purpose of your project theme and the advancement process, and achieve the established annual goal. In addition, the process can be reported in the Design Project Activity Support System.
(2) Compile intermediate results for the project into the interim report, and present its content. Complete the final report and present it to the Design Project III Public Presentation Review Board.
(3) Design and manufacture your own experimental devices if necessary.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This is the final comprehensive course in the Department of Mechanical Engineering. To realize the educational objectives of the Department of Mechanical Engineering, this course focuses on the following goals:

Students will acquire the ability to model phenomena accurately and analyze the models.
Students will acquire the ability and the engineering sense to evaluate solutions using the obtained results.

In practice, students should reconfirm their project theme, which was determined in Preparatory Seminar, with the supervisors of the individual laboratories. (The theme should be revised as necessary.)
Students are expected to pursue the identification and solution of problems in accordance with the engineering process.

Our laboratory employs plasticity and forming processing and related techniques. In addition, we aimed to train highly skilled and capable engineers. By studying rolling and forging processes, production technology having high added value is established, and products with high functionality are created. Furthermore, problems from different fields are addressed in cooperation with other local universities and companies.
